import sys
from copy import copy
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
sheet_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
header_row = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 1

wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb[sheet_name] if sheet_name else wb.worksheets[0]

headers = {}
for cell in ws[header_row]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        headers[str(cell.value).strip().lower()] = cell.column_letter

def find(names):
    for n in names:
        if n in headers:
            return headers[n]
    return None

rev = find(["revenue", "sales", "net sales", "turnover", "gross sales", "amount"])
prof = find(["profit", "net profit", "gross profit", "operating profit", "net income", "income"])
cost = find(["cost", "cogs", "cost of goods sold", "total cost", "expenses", "costs"])

if not rev:
    print("ERROR: no revenue column found. Headers:", headers)
    sys.exit(2)
if prof:
    def margin(row):
        return f'=IF({rev}{row}=0,"",{prof}{row}/{rev}{row})'
    desc = f"{prof} / {rev}"
elif cost:
    def margin(row):
        return f'=IF({rev}{row}=0,"",({rev}{row}-{cost}{row})/{rev}{row})'
    desc = f"({rev} - {cost}) / {rev}"
else:
    print("ERROR: neither profit nor cost column found. Headers:", headers)
    sys.exit(2)

print("Sheet:", ws.title, "| revenue:", rev, "| profit:", prof, "| cost:", cost, "| formula:", desc)

new_col = get_column_letter(ws.max_column + 1)
src = ws[f"{rev}{header_row}"]
hc = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=ws.max_column + 1)
hc.value = "Profit Margin (%)"
hc.font = copy(src.font)
hc.fill = copy(src.fill)
hc.border = copy(src.border)
hc.alignment = copy(src.alignment)

for r in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    c = ws[f"{new_col}{r}"]
    c.value = margin(r)
    c.number_format = "0.0%"

ws.column_dimensions[new_col].width = 16
wb.save(path)
print("Saved. New column:", new_col)

import os
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
ET.register_namespace("", NS)

path = "sales_data.xlsx"
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
entries = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}
zin.close()

sheet_xml = entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"]
styles_xml = entries["xl/styles.xml"]

# ---------- styles.xml: add numFmt 164 (0.0%) and a new xf ----------
sroot = ET.fromstring(styles_xml)
numfmts = sroot.find(f"{{{NS}}}numFmts")
if numfmts is None:
    numfmts = ET.Element(f"{{{NS}}}numFmts")
    sroot.insert(0, numfmts)
nf = ET.SubElement(numfmts, f"{{{NS}}}numFmt")
nf.set("numFmtId", "164")
nf.set("formatCode", "0.0%")
numfmts.set("count", str(len(numfmts.findall(f"{{{NS}}}numFmt"))))

cellxfs = sroot.find(f"{{{NS}}}cellXfs")
if cellxfs is None:
    raise SystemExit("styles.xml has no cellXfs")
newxf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f"{{{NS}}}xf")
newxf.set("numFmtId", "164")
newxf.set("fontId", "0")
newxf.set("fillId", "0")
newxf.set("borderId", "0")
newxf.set("xfId", "0")
newxf.set("applyNumberFormat", "1")
cellxfs.set("count", str(len(cellxfs.findall(f"{{{NS}}}xf"))))
new_style = str(len(cellxfs.findall(f"{{{NS}}}xf")) - 1)
new_styles = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

# ---------- sheet1.xml: add column H ----------
root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
dim = root.find(f"{{{NS}}}dimension")
dim.set("ref", "A1:H10")

cols = root.find(f"{{{NS}}}cols")
if cols is None:
    cols = ET.Element(f"{{{NS}}}cols")
    root.insert(1, cols)
colh = ET.SubElement(cols, f"{{{NS}}}col")
colh.set("min", "8")
colh.set("max", "8")
colh.set("width", "16")
colh.set("customWidth", "1")

sheetdata = root.find(f"{{{NS}}}sheetData")
added = 0
for row in sheetdata.findall(f"{{{NS}}}row"):
    rn = int(row.get("r"))
    cell = ET.SubElement(row, f"{{{NS}}}c")
    cell.set("r", f"H{rn}")
    if rn == 1:
        cell.set("s", "1")
        cell.set("t", "inlineStr")
        is_ = ET.SubElement(cell, f"{{{NS}}}is")
        t = ET.SubElement(is_, f"{{{NS}}}t")
        t.text = "Profit Margin"
    else:
        cell.set("s", new_style)
        f_ = ET.SubElement(cell, f"{{{NS}}}f")
        f_.text = f'IF(E{rn}=0,"",G{rn}/E{rn})'
        ET.SubElement(cell, f"{{{NS}}}v")
    added += 1
new_sheet = ET.tostring(root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

# ---------- write back ----------
tmp = path + ".tmp"
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n, data in entries.items():
        if n == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
            data = new_sheet
        elif n == "xl/styles.xml":
            data = new_styles
        zout.writestr(n, data)
os.replace(tmp, path)

print(f"Added column H ('Profit Margin') to rows 2-10 (formula IF(E#=0,\"\",G#/E#)), style index {new_style}")
print("Cells added:", added)
print("Dimension:", dim.get("ref"))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"

z = zipfile.ZipFile("sales_data.xlsx")
root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

def cell_text(c):
    t = c.get("t")
    if t == "inlineStr":
        ts = c.find(f"{{{NS}}}is/{{{NS}}}t")
        return ts.text if ts is not None else ""
    v = c.find(f"{{{NS}}}v")
    f = c.find(f"{{{NS}}}f")
    if f is not None:
        return f"={f.text} -> {v.text if v is not None and v.text else ''}"
    return v.text if v is not None else ""

print("dimension:", root.find(f"{{{NS}}}dimension").get("ref"))
for row in root.find(f"{{{NS}}}sheetData"):
    rn = row.get("r")
    out = []
    for c in row.findall(f"{{{NS}}}c"):
        out.append(f"{c.get('r')}:{cell_text(c)}")
    print(f"row {rn}: " + " | ".join(out))
